title: How AI Is Reshaping China's Industrial Policy
desc: Can Chinese tech companies help the country achieve technological self-reliance while keeping up in the AI arms race? On this episode, we speak with Kyle Chan, a fellow at the Brookings Institution’s John L. Thornton China Center and author of the High Capacity newsletter, about Beijing’s response to the global AI boom and the tensions between Chinese companies’ commercial ambitions and the government’s long-term plans. He explains how companies draw on shared expertise and supply chains to expand across industries including smartphones, robotics, EVs and semiconductors — and we also discuss Huawei’s efforts to compete with Nvidia and why technological success doesn’t necessarily translate into strong returns for stock investors in China. (Source: Bloomberg)

Putin Gains From Trump, Xi Summit Spotlight
desc: Bloomberg News White House Correspondent Jeff Mason tells Bloomberg This Weekend that Vladimir Putin emerged as a key beneficiary of his historic meeting with President Donald Trump and Xi Jinping, returning to the global stage alongside the US and Chinese leaders despite Russia’s continuing war in Ukraine. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Mason says the summit reflected Trump’s preference for leader-level diplomacy and explains why a Democratic-controlled Congress and Stephen Miller’s appointment as White House chief of staff are unlikely to fundamentally change the president’s foreign policy approach. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Just Ice Tea Builds on Honest Tea’s Legacy

Speaking with host Lisa Mateo, they discuss changing consumer tastes, their approach to organic and fair-trade sourcing and why they see room for a mission-driven brand in the growing ready-to-drink tea market. (Source: Bloomberg)

Anthropic IPO Fails to Calm AI Jitters
desc: Seaport Research Partners Chief Equity Strategist Jonathan Golub tells Bloomberg This Weekend the sharp AI-driven market selloff looks overdone, arguing that demand for computing power remains strong and semiconductor earnings expectations continue to rise. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Golub says a bigger challenge is whether markets can keep financing the enormous capital needs of AI companies as investors are asked to fund hundreds of billions of dollars in new infrastructure. (Source: Bloomberg)

Trump’s Putin Outreach Tests Ukraine Talks

Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Jamrisko discusses European skepticism toward Putin, tensions within the Trump administration and Vice President JD Vance’s effort to distinguish his views as he looks toward 2028. (Source: Bloomberg)
